serverInfo.name: @guardbee/mcp-reverse-shield
serverInfo.description: MCP server that audits shipped apps for how easily they can be reverse engineered — exposed source maps, missing minification/R8/.NET obfuscation, debug info and unstripped symbols, debuggable flags, Electron fuses, unsigned binaries and embedded secrets across web bundles, Electron, Android APK/AAB, iOS IPA, Unity, PyInstaller, Java and native/.NET binaries — with baselines for CI and build-config fix suggestions

tools.name: scan_artifact
tools.description: Audit a shipped build artifact for how easily it can be reverse engineered — the defensive counterpart to reverse-engineering MCPs. Accepts an APK, an Electron app (.app bundle, app folder or app.asar), a macOS/Linux/Windows binary (Mach-O, ELF, PE, .NET assembly), a JavaScript bundle or source map, or a build output directory containing any of these. Reports shipped source maps and source code, missing minification/R8/.NET obfuscation, debug info and unstripped symbols, debuggable flags and entitlements, Electron fuses that allow Node/inspector/ASAR tampering, missing code signing, embedded credentials and internal hosts, with an A–F grade.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the artifact or build output directory

maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files to check in a directory (default: 5000)

include.description: Only check files whose path contains one of these strings

exclude.description: Skip files/dirs whose path contains one of these strings

ignore.description: Accepted findings to leave out: a rule id, or rule:path-substring (e.g. bundle_secret:firebase-config.js)

baseline.description: Path to a baseline written by `guardbee-reverse-shield scan --update-baseline`; the report then lists new and fixed findings

tools.name: scan_url
tools.description: Check a live website the way an analyst starts: fetch the page, read its same-site JavaScript bundles, follow sourceMappingURL comments and try <bundle>.map even when the comment was stripped. Reports publicly downloadable source maps (and whether they embed the original sources), unminified or development bundles, embedded credentials and internal hosts. Third-party scripts are not fetched.

maxScripts.description: Maximum number of same-site scripts to fetch (default: 25)

tools.name: suggest_fixes
tools.description: Read a project's build configuration (Vite, webpack, Next.js, Angular, Create React App, Android Gradle and manifest, React Native, electron-builder / Forge, .NET project files, Flutter) and propose the changes that close what scan_artifact reports: hidden source maps, minification, R8, debuggable and backup flags, Hermes, Electron fuses and ASAR, no embedded PDB. Returns unified diffs to review and apply (git apply); it never modifies files.

projectPath.description: Project source directory (not the build output)

tools.name: list_checks
tools.description: List every reverse-engineering resistance check, grouped by target (web, electron, android, ios, native, dotnet, framework), with what each finding gives away and how to fix it
